body.title: feat(list): lower default --max to 50
body.body:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:
`helm list` currently fetches up to 256 releases by default, which is slow on clusters with many releases and rarely what users want to see in a terminal. This lowers the default for `--max` to 50 and updates the help text accordingly. Users who need more can still pass `--max`.

**Special notes for your reviewer**:
Small change confined to `pkg/cmd/list.go`.

**If applicable**:
- [x] this PR contains user facing changes (the `docs needed` label should be applied if so)
- [ ] this PR contains unit tests
- [ ] this PR has been tested for backwards compatibility

commit.message:
feat(list): lower default --max to 50 to speed up listing on large clusters

Signed-off-by: Swift <theycallmeswift@gmail.com>

body.patch:
@@ -56,7 +56,7 @@ Only items that match the filter will be returned.
 If no results are found, 'helm list' will exit 0, but with no output (or in
 the case of no '-q' flag, only headers).
 
-By default, up to 256 items may be returned. To limit this, use the '--max' flag.
+By default, up to 50 items may be returned. To limit this, use the '--max' flag.
 Setting '--max' to 0 (or a negative value) will return all results. Pairing
 the '--max' flag with the '--offset' flag allows you to page through results.
 `

 	f.BoolVar(&client.Failed, "failed", false, "show failed releases")

 	f.IntVar(&client.Offset, "offset", 0, "next release index in the list, used to offset from start value")
